Elena Park: Heads-up everyone 5: all-hands Wed 10:00 AM PT (hybrid). Join on-site in HQ Room B or via Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/ah-1799991234 :calendar:
Elena Park: Proposed flow: 1) 6m company-level metrics & context, 2) product highlights (Dedicated GA + Routing UI), 3) reliability summary & incident learnings, 4) hiring slots + org changes, 5) 10m live Q&A. Target total 50m, then 10m overflow for followups.
Elena Park: Please drop any Qs below you want prioritized. If you want to be anonymous, use the anonymous form linked in the calendar event or DM me.
Aj Chen: Can we squeeze in a quick 4-minute demo of the routing policy UI? Good for integrators and support folks. :eyes:
Elena Park: Yep adding a 4-min demo after product highlights. Thanks Aj.
Sanjay Rao: Will the Dedicated GA notes include the rollout window and whether per-tenant metrics land in Console or only in logs? Tagging product folks.
Aj Chen: We'll cover rollout timeline and metric surface targets; if we don't fully finalize, we'll call out a follow-up doc.
Maria Gomez: Logistics note: Room B capacity ~45. We'll have vegan & omnivore boxed lunches. If you need an accommodation, ping #people-ops or DM me. Also plan for mics in the room for hybrid Qs.
Elena Park: We plan to highlight two customer use-cases (short case quote + 90s demo). PMs: ping Aj if you have a customer clip to include.
Sanjay Rao: Question to add: will the Dedicated GA include support for per-region fallback routing or is that later? Adding here in thread.
Aj Chen: Noted; we'll aim to address region fallback in the infra/reliability segment.
Elena Park: Ops action: if you're attending in person, badge in at 9:40am so catering setup isn't delayed.
ops-bot: Calendar event updated: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/ah-2026-04-07 (recording will be attached after meeting)
Maria Gomez: Recording + auto captions enabled. We'll upload recording, transcript, and a bullets doc to #all-hands-notes within a few hours.
Aj Chen: Will the slide deck be published post-call? Helpful for teams that can't make it.
Elena Park: Yes slides + link to recording will be posted. If you want a specific slide included, share it by EOD today.
ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/recordings/ah-1799991234.mp4 Transcript: https://files.redwood.example/transcripts/ah-1799991234.vtt
Elena Park: Thanks everyone 5. If we miss anything crucial in the meeting, add notes to the doc or DM me. Looking forward to a tight session. :sparkles:
